'''Luigi San Nicolás Schellens''' (born 28 June 1992) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes|Atlètic d'Escaldes]] as a [[Forward (association football)|striker]]

==Career==
Born in [[Escaldes-Engordany]], San Nicolás has played club football for [[FC Andorra]], [[CE Principat]], [[FC Santa Coloma]], [[FC Ordino]], [[FC Lusitanos]], [[UE Engordany]] and [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes|Atlètic d'Escaldes]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=70689|accessdate=6 April 2021}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2018.<ref name = "NFT"/>
